Maria (support): Heads-up: multiple customers reporting 504s hitting /v1/hosted-infer/stream in us-east-1 around 16:02 UTC. One customer (AcmePay) just escalated. Correlation ID: cid=acme-0a1b2c. Curl repro attached. :rotating_light:
Alex (acme-customer): Confirming - started ~16:00, ~30-40% of requests get 504s, affects long-poll/streaming only. Very visible in prod.
Dan (eng-sre): Thanks, Maria. Is this streaming with chunked responses (server-sent) or plain long compute requests? Any example request size / model?
Maria (support): It's the streaming endpoint (chunked). Model is text-generation-large, typical input tokens ~600, sometimes 4-6s to first chunk then longer for rest. Repro: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \"https://hosted.redwood.example/v1/hosted-infer/stream\" -d @payload.json --no-buffer`  -> `HTTP/2 504` after ~31s.
Lee (eng-runtime): I'm seeing a spike in upstream latency but also a surge of upstream RST_STREAM in the ingress logs. Could be read_timeout on the proxy closing before the backend finishes streaming.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: ingress-config v2026.03.18-1124 (by infra-deploy).
Jenna (oncall): Rollout around 15:58 UTC—that matches. @Dan @Lee can we confirm if ingress read_timeout was changed in this deploy?
Dan (eng-sre): Pulling the deploy diff now. One sec...
Dan (eng-sre): Confirmed: nginx `proxy_read_timeout` was lowered from 90s -> 30s in the new ingress template (intended to kill stuck connections). That explains 30s cutoff.
Priya (cs): Customer impact: two enterprise tenants hit 30% error rate on streaming. They're asking for rollback or workaround.
Lee (eng-runtime): This is nasty because some streaming workloads legitimately take >30s to stream final tokens. Lowering read_timeout breaks those. Also noticed readiness probe flapping on a subset of pods around same time (readiness failing under auth throttling).
Maria (support): Customer wants immediate mitigation. Suggested: route their traffic to us-west-2 as temporary fallback, or rollback ingress change. Which is faster?
Jenna (oncall): Easiest fast mitigation: revert the ingress template change (rollback) — but that requires deploy pipeline and e2e smoke which takes ~15-20 min. Bumping the ingress timeout can be done via hotfix config and has to go through infra, ~10-15 min. Routing a tenant to another region requires tenant warmup and may be disruptive.
Dan (eng-sre): I'm going to push a hotfix to set `proxy_read_timeout 120s` for the streaming route only and increase `proxy_send_timeout` as well. Will monitor.
SRE-bot: NOTE: applying config patch to ingress (hotfix-1738209991) in progress...
Dan (eng-sre): Patch applied to canary nginx pool at 16:10 UTC. Canary logs show Streaming requests now hold open beyond 30s and finish successfully.
Alex (acme-customer): Seeing immediate improvement in a few requests. Still some failures but error-rate down from 35% -> ~6% so far. Thank you. :thumbsup:
Maria (support): Marking mitigation: hotfix applied, telemetry shows error-rate falling. Opening a follow-up runbook and ticket for rollback trace.
Lee (eng-runtime): Root causes: 1) ingress change lowered proxy_read_timeout to 30s; 2) readiness probes flapped because auth service started rate-limiting token validation under burst, causing occasional 503s from backend and contributing to upstream resets. We'll track both.
Jenna (oncall): Immediate next steps: revert global 30s change -> set streaming route to 120s, add guard to deploy pipeline to prevent timeout config from dropping below 60s for streaming routes. Also create alert on proxy_5xx_by_route to catch regressions.
Dan (eng-sre): I'll create the infra PR to revert and add pipeline guard. Link: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/ingress/merge/1234 (will update).
Priya (cs): Notifying impacted enterprise accounts and sending ETA for permanent fix + postmortem.
Maria (support): Customer wants reproduction steps included in the postmortem; I'll paste their curl + minimal payload and timeline.
Alex (acme-customer): Sharing sample traces: trace IDs acme-0a1b2c, acme-0a1b9f, acme-0a1c10 (16:00-16:07 UTC). Happy to share pcap if needed.
Dan (eng-sre): Saved traces. Postmortem items: (a) revert/guard, (b) add canary e2e streaming smoke test to deploy pipeline, (c) re-evaluate readiness probe backoff during auth bursts, (d) improve customer-facing incident message templates.
Jenna (oncall): After hotfix, we'll keep canary at 10% for 30m then roll fully if stable. I'll own the rollout.
SRE-bot: Reminder: open incident ticket ID INC-2026-0420 created and assigned to eng-sre.
Maria (support): Thanks all — I'll update Acme and close the support escalation if numbers hold. Will attach timeline and the hotfix runbook.
Dan (eng-sre): Leaving follow-ups for next-day: correlate auth token rotation events with readiness flaps, and add a slow-stream SLA test in nightly jobs.
Priya (cs): Thanks team. Customer pinged: "we appreciate fast response". Closing loop once postmortem link is ready. :pray:
